description: Canonical Ed25519 fixture for the BCS-encoded Blast X creator-claim attestation.
signature_scheme: Ed25519 over the exact BCS bytes, without an additional intent or hash wrapper
bcs_fields_in_order: meme: std::type_name::TypeName using original package IDs

cases.name: valid_claim
cases.notes: The meme field is the canonical TypeName built with original package IDs; the zero package address is the named-address value under Move unit tests and a generated coin's published original package ID is used in production. No schema version, action tag, nonce, Blast package ID, or launch ID is signed. The fixture private key was discarded and is not included. The X identity commitment is already a 32-byte value; this fixture covers attestation encoding and verification, not the separate stable-user-id commitment algorithm. claim_call_attestation_bcs_hex is the value inside Some(vector<u8>): little-endian expiry_ms followed by the BCS vector length byte 0x40 and the 64-byte signature.
